episodes.title: Epstein survivors back Talarico, urge Paxton to sue DOJ over redacted files
episodes.description:
Democratic State Representative James Talarico and Jeffrey Epstein survivors used a traveling exhibit in Dallas to call on Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton to support them and sue the Department of Justice over the handling of Epstein's files.

episodes.description: In 2011, a jury found Swami Prakashanand Saraswati guilty on 20 counts of indecency with a child.

episodes.title: Religious leader convicted of sex crimes disappears
episodes.description: In 2011, a jury found Swami Prakashanand Saraswati guilty on 20 counts of indecency with a child. The key testimony came from three victims who detailed how the Hindu leader molested them for years at the Barsana Dham temple in Hays County.

episodes.title: Report: Fugitive Swami may be in India
episodes.description: Court documents show that a Hindu guru who became a fugitive after being convicted of molesting two teenagers at his Texas ashram is likely in India.

episodes.title: Jeffs found guilty on both charges - 6 pm News
episodes.description: The sentencing phase was set to begin after the jury took a brief recess. The jury resumed and then broke for the day just after 6 p.m. Proceedings will resume at 9 a.m. on Friday.

episodes.title: Jeffs trial on hold after motion
episodes.description: The trial of polygamist leader Warren Jeffs is on hold after he filed another motion to remove the judge presiding over the case.

episodes.title: Warren Jeffs trial
episodes.description: A surprise development in the trial of polygamist leader Warren Jeffs: He stood up in court and dismissed his team of attorneys.

episodes.title: Second day of jury selection
episodes.description: The second day for jury selection in the trial for Warren Jeffs is under way.

episodes.title: Jury selection under way
episodes.description: Jury selection continues in the Warren Jeffs trial.

episodes.title: Jeffs trial jury selection
episodes.description: After months of delays, jury selection begin s Monday in polygamist leader Warren Jeffs' trial.

episodes.title: Warren Jeffs' request denied
episodes.description: For the second time, polygamist church leader Warren Jeffs' request to get a new judge has been denied.

episodes.title: Polygamist wants judge removed
episodes.description: The polygamist sect leader facing sexual assault and bigamy charges is trying to get the judge removed from his upcoming trial.

episodes.title: Swamiji bond money
episodes.description: A California businessman might have to give up $10 million because a convicted Hindu leader is on the run.

episodes.title: Hays County could keep Swamiji's bond
episodes.description: A hearing has been set for Monday in a Hays County to determine whether entrepreneur Peter Spiegel should forfeit the $10 million personal recognizance bond he posted on Swamiji's behalf.

episodes.title: Search for guilty guru
episodes.description: The Hindu religious leader known as Swamiji convicted of molesting two girls trying to flee the country is likely hiding in a Mexican border town trying to bribe his way onto a flight to India.  That's according to the U.S. Marshals Service.

episodes.title: Convicted guru disappears
episodes.description: Testimony is under way in the sentencing trial of a Hindu guru who has been a no-show for the past two days.

episodes.title: Guru skipped out on sentencing hearing - 6 pm News
episodes.description: Hays County District Attorney Sherri Tibbe said the warrant was issued for Prakashanand Saraswati, also known as Shree Swamiji, after he didn't show up to the punishment phase set to begin Monday.

episodes.title: Guru skipped out on sentencing hearing - 5 pm News
episodes.description: Hays County deputies are searching for Saraswati Prakashandand, convicted last week of 20 counts of indecency with a child. He is believed to be with a woman named Vishwambhari Devi.

episodes.title: Verdict in guru sex case: Guilty
episodes.description: The trial of a Hindu guru concluded on Friday afternoon. The jury returned a guilty verdict on all 20 counts -- 10 counts for the two girls who allegedly were abused.

episodes.title: Swamiji defense testimony
episodes.description: Defense testimony started Tuesday in the San Marcos trial of a Hindu guru accused in sexually abusing girls.

episodes.title: Polygamist leader back in Texas
episodes.description: Polygamist sect leader Warren Jeffs is now in a Texas jail.
